quest.title: Wanderer's Trail
quest.description: The god took away your only kin, and you were sealed and cast into a deep slumber. Upon your awakening, you wandered alone for a time until you met a strange companion named Paimon, thus beginning your journey through the continent of Teyvat...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x225, Mora x975, Character EXP x500

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay, let's take the route we planned!

talks.objective: Go to the foot of the cliff
Climb to the top of the rock face

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The path ends here — guess we'll just have to <color=#00E1FFFF>climb</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: <color=#00E1FFFF>Climbing</color> depletes <color=#00E1FFFF>stamina</color>, and depleted stamina takes time to recover!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're off to... a Statue of The Seven!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which of The Seven are you looking for exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You said we'd watch the sunrise together, how are you still asleep?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #The sun is out so rise and shine! If you wanna find your {M#sister}{F#brother}, we'll need you up and at 'em!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Once you're ready, gimme a shout.
